messages:
pavan_sales: Asterra asked if we can POC next week for their orchestration hooks. They want to validate 'aster-13b-slim' and a quant variant (q4_0) for low-latency streaming. Also sent their security questionnaire. Can we triage?

sara_se: I can handle variant checks. Quick question: do they rely on long shared contexts or mostly short commands?

pavan_sales: Mostly short commands (20-40 tokens) but they sometimes attach a 1k token prompt for state. Mix sounds ~90% short, 10% long.

nate_ops: Note: aster-13b-slim historically works with row-kv and tiled-kv. Row-kv gives better tail latencies for mixed traffic. We'll need to run a micro-bench with concurrency 12 to simulate their agent fanout.

olga_sec: From the security side: questionnaire flagged "customer-managed keys" and "data residency". They also want confirmation around vulnerability scans on model artifacts. Hosted is preferred for POC, Dedicated later.

miguel_prod: For hosted POC we can offer BYOK (KMS passthrough) but HSM-backed keys would need Dedicated/Private. We should clarify expectations in the questionnaire.

bench-bot: Creating ephemeral dev cluster for aster-13b-slim tests. Job ID 92011.

nate_ops: Suggested bench command (internal):

```bash
redwood-bench --model aster-13b-slim --quant q4_0 --kv-layout row-kv --seq-dist aster-seq.json --concurrency 12 --streaming true --measure p95,p99,tokens_per_sec
```

nate_ops: I'll run two sweeps: q4_0 + float16 baseline, and row-kv vs tiled-kv. Will post numbers.

sara_se: I'll prep a small eval harness to diff outputs on their representative prompts (they promised 60). Need to confirm whether deterministic sampling is required for accuracy diffs.

olga_sec: On model audits: we can attach last onboarding report and checksum manifest. If they require third-party attestation we can propose a scoped review under Dedicated.

nate_ops: Bench pass 1 (quick): concurrency 12, mostly short traces p95 float16 = 95ms, q4_0 = 120ms. With 1k-token spike traces p95 float16 = 480ms, q4_0 = 610ms. Row-kv reduced p99 by ~15% vs tiled for mixed workload.

miguel_prod: That tail is acceptable for many interactive agents but for tight SLAs we should propose prefix-KV caching and the qv-canary only for non-critical commands.

sara_se: On quality diffs: q4_0 has minor tokenization/number formatting differences on ~4% of their sample prompts (draft results). I'll run a targeted pass on the 60 prompts and produce a delta table.

pavan_sales: Timeline: Asterra demo scheduled Thurs. Can we have bench + security answers + a one-page POC pricing card by Wed EOD?

miguel_prod: I'll sketch the POC offer: 2-week hosted block with discounted token rates, option to upgrade to Dedicated with HSM. I'll post details in a private thread.

olga_sec: Draft sec answers: BYOK + encrypted at rest + audit report attached. For residency: we can run POC in EU region if required. Flagging data flow for PHI-like fields; we need explicit confirmation.

nate_ops: Action items recap: @sara_se run q4_0 vs float16 diff on 60 prompts; @nate_ops run bench sweeps (doing now); @olga_sec respond to questionnaire and attach audit docs; @miguel_prod prepare POC pricing card. Deliver Wed EOD.

bench-bot: Job 92011 completed: aster-13b-slim v2.0 deployed on dev-pool.

sara_se: Uploaded preliminary diff summary: 4% divergence, mostly numeric formatting and a few stop-token differences. Detailed CSV in PR.

pavan_sales: CSM confirmed they'll send the 60 prompts by EOD today. Thanks team. I'll update Asterra that demo is tentative pending quality check. :thumbsup:

olga_sec: If they insist on HSM for hosted POC escalate to solutions + sales. Otherwise BYOK hosted + EU region should satisfy most asks.

miguel_prod: Good work. Once final diffs are in we can recommend either use q4_0 for latency-sensitive paths and float16 for critical commands. I'll sync with solutions for migration playbook.

pavan_sales: Great. I'll close the loop with Asterra after we have final numbers.
